world.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
world.description: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

world.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
world.description: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

world.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
world.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

world.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry

world.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
world.description: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

world.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
world.description: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.

world.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone

world.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge

world.title: Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration

world.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
world.description: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

world.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
world.description: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.

world.title: Russia's new jet-powered drones outpacing Ukraine's air defences with daily launches
world.description: The new models can travel at speeds of up to 300mph, faster than Ukraine's air defence interceptors.

world.title: Four key takeaways from  Republican midterms convention
world.description: The US president covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.

US.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
US.description: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

US.title: Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured
US.description: The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.

US.title: A pilot of the Amazon cargo plane in Miami crash warned it was coming in too fast
US.description: For nearly two minutes, one of the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that careened off a Miami runway repeatedly warned his counterpart they were going too fast, according to flight information.

US.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
US.description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

US.title: A huge 11th-century tapestry of the Norman Conquest has (carefully) traveled to England
US.description: Part war propaganda, part comic strip, the 230-foot Bayeux Tapestry is back in England for the first time in 900 years. It depicts the 1066 Battle of Hastings, which ended Anglo-Saxon rule.

US.title: Conductor Julian Wachner receives suspended sentence for possession of child sex abuse material
US.description: The formerly prominent, widely recorded conductor was sentenced Wednesday to nearly six years of probation for five counts of possession of child sex abuse material in Indianapolis.

US.title: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
US.description: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.
